title: Marrakech Sets New Summer Tourism Record — Hotels Report 94% Occupancy in June
body:
Marrakech is experiencing its most successful tourism summer on record, with hotel occupancy rates reaching 94% across the city's 900-plus accommodation establishments in June 2026 — a 31% increase over June 2025.

World Cup Multiplier Effect

Industry analysts attribute the surge to Morocco's strong World Cup performances and the country's co-hosting role. American, Canadian and South American tourists are booking Marrakech as a World Cup adjacent destination.

Infrastructure Pressure

Taxi wait times have increased significantly at Menara Airport. The municipality has deployed additional buses on key tourist routes including Jemaa el-Fna, Majorelle Garden and Palais Bahia.

Data from the Marrakech Regional Tourism Council.
